immutable.original_gate: R3_PREREG R3_2.local_gate on VAL_SCALE stays FAILED for every candidate (af45f538c3); nothing below re-labels it

R3_3A_3d.question: Does the G1s improvement over F0 hold on new family-independent validation labels, in particular in dense enabler-chain layouts like the K4/K5 failure regime?
R3_3A_3d.families: original-VAL families with no DEV lineage and no physical exposure, not used by any R3.1 scene (TRAIN_SCALE or VAL_SCALE), N 5-9, one root per family, K_legacy >= 1 first (string 'NONE' not demoted, as R3.1), then sha256('R3.3A|scene|root'); strata in the cycle DENSE, DENSE, ORD; the first scene that does not fit closes its stratum
R3_3A_3d.ORD: the unchanged R3.1 Scene policy (templates T1-T7, HYPSTART every third ORD scene, k 3/2 alternating); cap 60 jobs
R3_3A_3d.DENSE: data.DenseScene (learner-visible cells only; no teacher / model score / label in the construction): pivot M (target-adjacent, most crowded), 1-2 E1 bodies moved next to M, one chain body E2 moved next to E1; templates D1 [M], D2 [E1|M], D3 [E2|E1], D4 [E2|E1 M], D5 [E1 M], D6 [M E1], D7 [R|M] (non-enabling), D8 [E1|M->dM2]; static start at ideal poses (R3.0 HYP parity 12/12); cap 140 jobs
R3_3A_3d.selection_bias_rule: no example selected by G1s or M1s predictions; ORD keeps R3.1's frozen-F0 'H' source; DENSE uses cVAE / hash only

budget.source: unspent R3.1 3D allocation (412 jobs / 17.2 CPU-h left); no retries; no continuation until a pass

evaluation.metrics: AUROC (family-cluster 95% CI), AUPRC, NLL, Brier, ECE, matched permutation concordance (T4/T5, D5/D6), first-relocation FPR at each model's own TPR-0.80 threshold with achieved TPR, FPR/TPR at 0.5, FPR at each model's ORIG_VAL_SCALE TPR-0.80 threshold (frozen threshold)
evaluation.strata: h0, h>=1, m1 vs m2-3 at each h, S0 vs static start (HYPSTART / DENSE) at h0, physically reached (h>=1) from S0 vs from static starts, N bins

decision.R3_3A_PASS: the ORIGINAL four gate components with unchanged thresholds on POOLED for G1s_s0 (support >= 10 mixed families at h0 and h>=1; h>=1 AUROC >= 0.75 with lower CI >= 0.60; paired h>=1 dAUROC vs F0 CI > 0; first-relocation FPR drop >= 0.15) AND two consistency guards on NEW alone (paired h>=1 dAUROC point > 0; FPR drop point > 0), because ORIG VAL_SCALE was used for G1s early stopping and seed selection
decision.R3_4_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: iff not R3_3A_PASS, the failure is narrow (support and h>=1 components pass and exactly one of {paired, FPR, guard-paired, guard-FPR} fails) and NEW_DENSE alone shows a positive paired intermediate-X improvement with adequate support (>= 10 mixed families at h>=1 and paired h>=1 dAUROC CI lower bound > 0); the original gate stays failed and R3.5 is not authorized

R3_4_3d.unchanged_from_R3_PREREG: 20 DEV_ORDER_3D roots, R2.4 known assignments (sorted; witness order hidden), exact subset DP (order.dp) with chunks 1-3, marginal local pX on canonical prefix scenes, LAM = -log 0.92, partition scored = partition executed, independent physical execution + endpoint target verification + replay; arms S-DP (G1s_s0), F0-DP (archived R2.4 A-DP), RANDOM (sha256('R3.4|'+root) + G1s best partition), WITNESS (archived split, reference); cap 80 jobs / 4 CPU-h

plans_sealed.note: contains G1s and F0 rankings of every order (witness rank computed only by the evaluator in analyze)

R3_4_3d.criterion: RECOVERED iff S-DP >= 14/20 verified AND S-DP - F0-DP net >= +5 roots with exact one-sided McNemar p < 0.05 AND the formal local gate passed; 10-13 PARTIAL; <= 9 NOT_RECOVERED; in DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY mode the same numbers are reported as diagnostic reference only (job keys 'R34DX', label DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY)
R3_4_3d.reported: per root: verified success, first failing relocation, failure reason, chunk sizes, reference returns, witness-order rank under G1s and F0, paired outcomes S-DP vs F0-DP and vs RANDOM, planning time and physical CPU
R3_4_3d.caution: AUROC gains are not assumed to transfer to physical ordering

REGR_3d.rule: R3_PREREG R3_2.k3_regression.physical: released EXACT4 (rank.b0, NOOP gate 0.5, eta 0.3) with the production F0 scorer vs G1s_s0 on the 338 NATURAL_VAL roots (same cVAE proposals)
REGR_3d.verification: changed roots in sha256('R3.REGR|'+root) order; both arms per root (exact v32 / archived reuse first, else one X_CHUNKED [m] + endpoint Y + replay job); a root is queued only if all its jobs fit; cap 60 jobs / 3 CPU-h
REGR_3d.estimator: panel delta = (changed / 338) x mean paired success delta on the verified (hash-random) changed subset; bootstrap 95% CI over that subset; 'no > 5 pp regression' claimed only if >= 10 verified changed roots and the CI lower bound > -5 pp; otherwise reported as unresolved
REGR_3d.success: REPAIR: X = 1 and Y = 1 (replayed for new jobs); NOOP: Y(empty) = 1 (v32 label); ABSTAIN: 0

R3_1D_2d.question: Does frozen 2D local X discriminate after one or more relocations when the prefix is independently established?
R3_1D_2d.design: data.build2dd: per clean original-VAL family (not in the R3.1 diagnostic; N 9-20; K_legacy != 0; one root per family; sha256('R3.1D|scene|root')): prefix p = a v32 X = 1 single relocation (continuous run incl. terminal connector == chunk [p], R3.0 parity); Q1 [p|b] (b = best frozen-pX cVAE single), Q2 [p|r] (random legal), Q3 [p|x y] (pair), Q4 [b] at S0 (before/after contrast)
R3_1D_2d.states: all h>=1 states are physically reached after the established prefix; no hypothetical-start scenes in 2D (the 2D teacher has no static start override and no 2D HYP parity was audited)
R3_1D_2d.labels: labels.chunks_of; UNKNOWN_PLANNER / UNKNOWN_TRANSIT preserved with reasons, never negatives
R3_1D_2d.decision: R3_1_2d.decision rule (>= 10 mixed families at h>=1; PASS if AUROC >= 0.75 and lower CI >= 0.60; DEFICIT if upper CI < 0.70; else INCONCLUSIVE) on the union R2.4 + R3.1 + R3.1D at h>=1; R3.1D alone reported; no 2D training in this tranche

R3_4D_2d_pilot.cohort: sealed DEV_ORDER_2D (30 CERTIFIED_MIN_K roots, 10 each K4/K5/K6); all 30 reported; reserve roots never substituted; no re-prediction after outcomes
R3_4D_2d_pilot.arms: FX-DP (frozen 2D F0, exact subset DP, chunks 1-3, LAM = -log 0.92), RANDOM (sha256('R3.4D|'+root) + frozen best partition), WITNESS (privileged order + frozen best partition; same chunk-boundary protocol)
R3_4D_2d_pilot.physical: physical2d X_CHUNKED (connector to q_ref at every boundary, independent replay); endpoint Y once per root (identical endpoint for every arm)
R3_4D_2d_pilot.report: strict all-root success (UNKNOWN = failure), decided-only, UNKNOWN coverage; by K, N, arm and failure location; paired FX-DP vs RANDOM and WITNESS vs FX-DP (exact McNemar)
